purpose: Implement invoice totals. In src/invoice.mjs replace total with an exported summarize(lines, discountBps=0) that returns {subtotalCents,discountCents,totalCents}. Every line needs nonnegative safe integer priceCents and quantity; lines must be an array; discountBps is an integer in 0..10000. Reject invalid values and unsafe multiplication/sums with RangeError. Round discount to nearest cent, with half cents rounding up, without losing integer precision. Preserve exported total(lines) as summarize(lines).totalCents. Empty lines return zeros.
task: Compile the supplied specification into one executable changeset plan.
